_doc: Every pair of answers from different splits that evals/overlap.py flags must have a decision here (docs/EVAL_PROTOCOL.md). decision: 'distinct' (kept: different cases despite the similarity) or 'duplicate' (one side removed or the pair disclosed as not independent). reviewer says who looked at both texts.

pairs.disclosed: Same code for two problems (binary-search vs search-rotated-array). Kept in both sets for history, recorded in datasets.json known_overlap: md-rotated-linear is not independent of tuning.
pairs.reviewer: the harness author (AI coding assistant, tuning session)
